title: EA600 3-Day Road Trip
summary: An ambitious three-day loop from Cambridge through the Fens, the Norfolk and Suffolk coasts, and back through Essex, with overnight stops in Cromer and Orford.
description:
Allow about 600 miles for this itinerary. Expect three substantial driving days and check distances for the roads and detours you choose.

Map pins show approximate stop locations. Check road directions and allow extra time for visits and seasonal access.

days.title: Cambridgeshire to Norfolk
days.description: Depart Cambridge and head north through the Fens, taking in Ely and its cathedral before continuing across Norfolk to the coast. The day finishes in Cromer, with time for the seafront, pier and traditional coastal town atmosphere.
days.highlights:
Cambridge
Ely Cathedral
Fenland landscapes
Norwich area
North Norfolk coast
Cromer Pier

days.title: Norfolk to Suffolk
days.route: Cromer → Norfolk Coast → Suffolk Coast → Orford
days.description: Explore the beaches, marshes and historic harbours west of Cromer before heading east towards Great Yarmouth. Continue south through Southwold and Aldeburgh to Orford, a riverside village beside the Alde estuary.
days.highlights:
Cromer
Sheringham
Wells-next-the-Sea
Holkham
Blakeney
Great Yarmouth area
Southwold
Aldeburgh
Orford

days.title: Suffolk and Essex return
days.route: Orford → Walton-on-the-Naze → Dedham Vale → Colchester → Maldon → Saffron Walden → Cambridge
days.description: Complete the southern and western arc of the loop. Travel via the Essex coast and estuaries, into Constable Country and the historic town of Colchester, then continue through Maldon and the north-west Essex countryside before returning to Cambridge.
days.highlights:
Orford
Walton-on-the-Naze
Dedham Vale
Flatford
Colchester
Maldon
Saffron Walden
Cambridge

title: EA600 14-Day Road Trip
summary: Take two weeks to explore the EA600 loop across Cambridgeshire, Norfolk, Suffolk and Essex. The itinerary leaves time for coastal walks, historic towns and village detours before a full day in Cambridge.
description:
The day-by-day planning estimates add up to about 665 miles, including the itinerary’s detours. The last day is for exploring Cambridge without a driving leg.

Map pins show approximate stop locations. Check road directions and allow extra time for visits and seasonal access.
